svg.title: Hyperliquid: users and monetization diverge
svg.desc: Earlier window = 100; recent indices use the reported percentage changes. Recent: 2026-09-13–10-12 UTC | Earlier: 2025-10-13–11-11 UTC. Project-series volume is not platform-wide perpetual notional volume. These are not strict YoY windows.
